page.metaDescription: Privacy information for the BCSentinel website and contact requests.
page.title: Privacy Policy
page.lead: Information about personal-data processing when using the website, contacting us, or making product-related enquiries.
page.notice: This page is an operational working draft and does not replace individual legal advice. Before public go-live, the controller, hosting, service providers, and product processing must be reviewed and finalized.

sections.title: 2. General information
paragraphs: Personal data means information that can identify a person directly or indirectly. We process data only where necessary for website operation, contact handling, contracts, or legal obligations.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and server logs
paragraphs: When the website is accessed, the IP address, time, browser, operating system, referrer, and requested resource may be processed for delivery, stability, and security.
The currently intended hosting provider is Hetzner Online GmbH. The final production configuration must be verified before go-live.

sections.title: 4. Fonts
paragraphs: The website currently loads Google Fonts, which may create a connection to Google servers. Local hosting should be assessed before go-live to avoid external transfers.

sections.title: 5. Contact form and email
paragraphs: When you contact us, we generally process your name, email address, company, topic, and message to handle the request.
The contact form currently uses FormSubmit. Form data is sent to that service for forwarding to support@bcsentinel.com.
sections.note: FormSubmit's privacy and contractual terms, and a potential later migration to an internal backend, must be reviewed before public go-live.

sections.title: 6. Purposes and legal bases
items: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR – contract and pre-contractual steps
Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – legitimate interests, especially security, hosting, and request handling

sections.title: 7. Recipients
paragraphs: Recipients may include hosting, email, form, and technical operations providers where required for the processing purpose.

sections.title: 8. Retention
paragraphs: Data is stored only as long as necessary for the purpose or applicable legal retention duties.

sections.title: 10. Data security
paragraphs: We use appropriate technical and organizational measures. Details on the currently implemented product architecture are available on the Security page.

sections.title: 11. BCSentinel product use
paragraphs: For production use, data categories, scope, storage locations, roles, deletion processes, and tenant separation must be finalized and reflected in the production privacy policy.

sections.title: 12. Changes
paragraphs: This policy will be updated when services, processing activities, or legal requirements change.
